description: This PHP script handles a quick search query for the SuiteCRM module 'Home'. It includes functionality for loading a custom or default quicksearch class, decodes incoming request data, sanitizes input fields, processes search conditions, and invokes a method on a quicksearchQuery object to perform the search.

classes.name: quicksearchQuery
classes.description: A class responsible for handling quick search queries within the SuiteCRM Home module, with methods as invoked dynamically in the script.

classes.name: quicksearchQueryCustom
classes.description: A custom extension of the quicksearchQuery class, used if available in the custom directory, overriding default quicksearchQuery functionality.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a search query based on provided data parameters.
